part_number.product: SEL-401 Protection, Automation, and Control Merging Unit
part_number.note: 25-character SEL-400-series part number. No SEL-401 Model Option Table has been published, so this block is calibrated from three sources: (1) the SEL-401 master drawing layers (i7201.C-i7206.D) which anchor positions 6, 10, 16, 18, 20 and 22; (2) the platform-sibling SEL-451-6 With Sampled Values/TiDL ordering doc (WI-15509), which supplies field semantics and option codes for the chassis (17), the INT I/O boards and their input-voltage second digit; and (3) genuine part numbers. The real SEL-401 part number 0401015X3400XD6H624C4XXXX (from an IM CONFIGURATION INFO screen) confirms the I/O section: board B '24' = INT2 (8 inputs / 15 outputs) at 125 Vdc, exactly matching that unit's reported I/O. Leading/middle fixed digits (5, 7, 8, 9, 11-15, 24-25) are constant across all known part numbers; their exact meaning is unconfirmed (merging-unit analog-input template). NOTE: the 2017-vintage real part number uses legacy codes not in the current option lists at position 10 ('4') and the position-C board card ('C'); current-production part numbers decode cleanly.
references: SEL-401 master configuration drawings i7201.C-i7206.D (drawing layers)
SEL-451-6 With Sampled Values or TiDL Technology Ordering Information (WI-15509, 20231221) - platform sibling, used for field semantics and option codes
SEL-401 Instruction Manual (401_IM_20250919) CONFIGURATION INFO screen - genuine part number

example_part_numbers.note: Genuine part number from an SEL-401 IM CONFIGURATION INFO screen (FID SEL-401-R400V0, 2017 build). Connector = screw terminal; horizontal rack mount; 3-I/O-board chassis; board B = INT2 (8 in / 15 out) @ 125 Vdc. Legacy: pos10 '4' and pos20 'C' predate the current option lists.
Representative current-production string (drawing i7203.D): screw terminal, four 10/100BASE-T Ethernet, horizontal rack mount, 3-board chassis, boards B/C = INT2 @125 Vdc, board D empty.
